description: Cost Alerting Service, Secret Rotation Automation, API Versioning Strategy, and Audit Log Export/Retention - four new modules implementing operational maturity features
steps: Create src/nexus/governance/cost_alerting.py with CostAlertService class that integrates with BudgetEnforcer's cost tracking. Include AlertThreshold (warn_pct, critical_pct), CostAlert dataclass (agent_id, scope, current_spend, limit, severity), and check_budgets() method. Support callback registration for alert delivery.

Enhance src/nexus/governance/secret_backend.py: add RotationPolicy dataclass (max_age_days, auto_rotate), add check_rotation_needed() method to FernetSecretBackend that identifies secrets past max_age, add rotation_history tracking (when each secret was last rotated).
Create src/nexus/api/routes/rotation.py with API routes for triggering secret rotation and viewing rotation status. Wire into main.py.

Create src/nexus/api/versioning.py with VersionedRouter that mounts routes under /api/v1/, adds X-API-Version: 1.0 response header, and supports deprecation mechanism (routes marked deprecated with sunset date in response headers). Wire into main.py.

Create src/nexus/governance/audit_export.py with AuditExporter class: export_range(start, end, format) supporting JSON and CSV, RetentionPolicy (max_age_days, archive_after_days), apply_retention() that archives old entries and purges ancient ones, atomic export to prevent partial reads.
Add comprehensive tests for all four modules: tests/test_cost_alerting.py, tests/test_secret_rotation.py, tests/test_api_versioning.py, tests/test_audit_export.py
acceptance_criteria: CostAlertService.check_budgets() correctly identifies over-budget scopes and fires callbacks
FernetSecretBackend.check_rotation_needed() returns secrets that are past max_age_days
VersionedRouter routes respond with X-API-Version header and support deprecated route sunset headers
AuditExporter.export_range() produces valid JSON and CSV output
AuditExporter.apply_retention() archives and purges entries according to policy
All new tests pass with pytest
verification: pytest (full suite passes with no regressions)
